payload.body: Cancelled. rangercrm is a private downstream product, not Frick framework code, and must not live in this repo. apps/rangercrm-server was a stale subset (201-line schema) of the live copy already maintained in the RangerCRM repo at ~/dev/RangerCRM/server (759-line schema, branch feat/frick-0.2-migration) — every entity in Frick verified present there. Removed apps/rangercrm-server from Frick; scrubbed the doc/AGENTS/builder.rs references; regenerated pnpm-lock. Any Rust library-embed port of the RangerCRM server happens in the RangerCRM repo, not here. The framework dogfood/parity burden stays on productTestSchema + the conformance suite (FR-250).
